structure.unit: Production and Sale of Agricultural Products

law.catch_line: Permit required to sell or transport plant pests
law.text: It is unlawful to sell, barter, offer for sale, move, transport, deliver, ship, or offer for shipment any plant pests without a permit from the Commissioner stating that such plant pests are: (i) not injurious; (ii) generally present already; or (iii) to be used for scientific purposes subject to specified safeguards.
